giving_description: Give online to New Life Hutto. Your generosity supports a small Apostolic church in Hutto, TX reaching families with the gospel. Secure giving through Church Center.
giving_main_html:
Give

Partner with us in reaching our community

Online giving is now through Planning Center, with secure payments processed by Stripe.

Give Securely Online

One-time or recurring gifts. No app needed.

If you're visiting for the first time, please know that you are absolutely not expected to give.

"Each of you should give what you have decided in your heart to give, not reluctantly or under compulsion, for God loves a cheerful giver." 2 Corinthians 9:7

Why We Give

At New Life Hutto, giving isn't about building a budget — it's about building the Kingdom. We're a small church, and that means every dollar matters. Your generosity directly supports our ability to keep the doors open, keep the lights on, and keep reaching families in Hutto and the surrounding communities with the gospel of Jesus Christ.

We believe in being transparent about where your money goes. As a church affiliated with the United Pentecostal Church International, we support global missions, local outreach, and the day-to-day operations of a church that's here to serve our community. There are no hidden agendas — just honest stewardship of what God provides through people like you.

If you're visiting for the first time, please know that you are absolutely not expected to give. This is for our regular members and those who feel led to support what God is doing here. No pressure, no guilt — ever.

A quick note for current givers

The first time you use the new page, you may need to enter your payment details again. If you already have an automatic giving arrangement, please contact us before setting up another one so we can help you avoid duplicate gifts.

Need a little more time to switch? You can still use our previous Breeze giving page during the transition. Thank you for supporting New Life as we rebuild.

Other Ways to Give

In Person

We receive offering during our Sunday worship service. Cash or check — whatever works for you. There's no awkward moment; the offering is a quiet, personal part of the service.

By Mail

Make checks payable to "New Life Church of Hutto" and mail to:

New Life Hutto
PO Box 1061
Hutto, TX 78634

Tax-Deductible Giving

New Life Church of Hutto Inc. is a registered 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization. All donations are tax-deductible to the full extent allowed by law. The church provides year-end giving statements for your records.

If you have questions about your giving history or need a receipt, contact us at office@newlifehutto.com.

Thank You for Your Generosity

Every gift, no matter the size, makes a difference in what God is doing through New Life Hutto. Thank you for partnering with us.

Plan Your Visit
